name: KC9503
summary: KC9503 is a SSOP16 servo-control IC in KCS’s robot and model-aircraft servo component portfolio. Requires external LDO, pre-driver and MOSFETs. Package and circuit requirements are taken from the manufacturer’s selection table; final electrical operating limits require the matching datasheet.
